Kai Xu徐凯

Associate Professor in Computer Science atSchool of Computer Science,University of Nottingham.

Co-director, Visualisation Research Group (VisTAG).

Get in touchGoogle ScholarGitHubLinkedInYouTube

I am an Associate Professor in theSchool of Computer Science at theUniversity of Nottingham, UK. I amco-director of the school'sVisualisation Research Group (VisTAG), an organiser of theVisualisation Interest Groupat the Alan Turing Institute, and chair of theUK branch of Eurographics.

My research sits at the intersection of data science anddata visualisation — presenting data visually so that people can find patterns using human cognition and domain knowledge. Currently I focus onhuman-centred AI: collaboration and teaming between people and machine learning systems, because the best results usually come from working together rather than either alone.

I have led research projects with a total value of over £12 million, funded by UK and EU research councils (EPSRC, EU Framework Programme), government bodies (Ministry of Defence, Dstl, US Department of Homeland Security) and industry (Microsoft, British Telecom).
